about: E101 INTRADAY-HTF door (fix/intraday-htf-door, 2026-11-28): the member door's runtime probe accepts an admitted higher intraday read on its chart-less daily base (deferredIntradayHtf, one predicate for requestTargetOf, lowerTfDeclineOf and lowerTfServedCodeOf), a compile-only column over zero bars is not refused for its missing chart, a source input inside a request reads the bar series it names, and Pine's price means read inside a request. Found by re-asking write-capability w02 / w19 live on production. Each mutant breaks one rule and must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: door-base: the door's daily-base probe takes an admitted intraday read as a lower-timeframe one again (w02 refused with the host's sentence)
mutants.expectRed: the script the assistant wrote for w02

mutants.mutant: compile-only: a column over zero bars with no chart is refused for its missing chart (w19's request(...)[1] table refused at the door)
source-input: a source input read inside a request falls through to the stateful-builtin refusal again
mutants.from: if (dv && dv.type === 'name' && MEMBER_SOURCES.has(dv.name)) return lowerExpr({ ...dv, tok: node.tok }, scope)

mutants.mutant: price-means: hl2 / hlc3 / ohlc4 / hlcc4 inside a request are a name nothing binds again
mutants.from: if (mean && scope.lookup(node.name) === null && !env.has(node.name)) return lowerExpr(mean(node.tok), scope)

mutants.mutant: hl2-arithmetic: hl2 inside a request divides by 3 (a wrong mean must not pass as the written arithmetic)

mutants.to: hl2: (t) => meanBin('/', meanBin('+', meanName('high', t), meanName('low', t), t), meanNum(3, t), t),
